note:
405 -> 399, and every unit of the -6 is a check that now says what it means.

Measured the way py_typecheck.yml prescribes: mypy 2.3.0 and NOTHING ELSE in the venv, --no-incremental, `-p odoo.tools`, in a `git archive` tree of HEAD plus this change. Two consecutive runs, 399 both times.

  safe_eval        `expr` is `str | bytes | CodeType` and the CodeType guard is an
                   isinstance, so the check the annotation had made unreachable is
                   reachable again; the bytes branch decodes once instead of dying
                   in `"format" in expr`; `mode` and `context` are validated with
                   raises rather than asserts.
  sass_embedded    `result` was a canonical URL in one branch and a
                   (contents, syntax) pair in the other; two names now.
  js extractor     `inside_str` was False-or-quote-character, so every non-string
                   character compared a bool against a str.

The safe_eval half is not only a count: `-O` strips asserts, and those two were
the input validation on a sandbox entry point. A mode the compiler does not know
reached `compile()` unchecked, and a dict *subclass* -- whose `__getitem__` the
evaluated code would then run against as its globals -- passed the context check.
`type(context) is dict` is kept over isinstance for that reason and now says so.
